6. Electric Distribution System:
Within the Conservation Areas existing overhead electric distribution facilities will be relocated to the alleys wherever possible. Within the Redevelopment Area electric distribution facilities shall be placed underground. (See Figure 6, Exhibit 7).
7. Telephone System:
Within the Conservation Area existing overhead telephone service facilities will be relocated to the alleys wherever possible. Within the Redevelopment Areas telephone service facilities shall be placed underground.
